moments.text: Grey-scale infrared view from far off: dark plume puffs above a flat pale layer, a snowy summit on the horizon. Grey boxes hide text at the top.
The screen flashes white, black and grey, then shows a closer view of dark billowing plume clouds.
Zoomed on the snow-covered volcano summit: dark plume clouds roll across the lower slopes and dark smoke rises beside the crater.
The view moves closer to the crater, with a dark fan-shaped streak down the snowy slope; haze slowly thickens over the summit.
After a white flash, a wider view of the summit and plume, then the sensor swings into the plume clouds.
Zoomed into the plume: a small dark round spot, sometimes with a pale edge, drifts across dark and light patches of plume, often away from the crosshair.
The view goes soft: a large dark ring with a lighter centre sits around the crosshair, fading in and out.
A flat grey screen, then the view widens over dark, lumpy plume clouds seen from above.
The picture switches to colour for about 4 s: pink, then blue-tinted clouds.
Back to infrared, zoomed in: a bright white spot with a dark core sits just above the crosshair box on a plain grey background.
The screen flashes black, then stays plain white for about 3 s.
Infrared returns on a wide view of dark plume clouds, nearly still, until the clip ends.

notes: Left ~15% of the frame is a flat grey strip (padding/redaction), not cropped.
